title: 第二十六章邀请各方求收藏第二十五章集镇城

第二十六章邀请各方
刘雷怎么也没想到，自己看中的女人，竟是的陈林的女人。虽然对陈林很不屑，但是最意外的是陈林身边竟然有一名七阶的高手保护，要知道七阶的护卫，那怕是在陈家也是有很高的地位的。
“这个被逐出家门的陈林，怎么会有这么强的护卫？”不过转念一想，刘雷有冷笑起来“难道只有你有七阶的高手吗？一个被驱逐的人在边境突然死亡，陈家也不会有什么反应的……”
话说陈林在废掉刘雷的手下后，直接就和翠儿回到了城主府，不过陈林并不打算就这么算了，陈林本就是一个有仇必报的人，这个刘雷两次得罪他，陈林本就不打算这么算了。
这次主要是因为翠儿在，陈林害怕伤害到翠儿，所以并没有直接发作，在回到城主府后，直接命令下人“去，将陈有财叫来，说我有事找他商议，让他放下手中的所有事过来。”
只是一会，陈有财就飞快的跑了过来“少爷，你找我有事啊？”
看着跑得满头大汗的陈有财，陈林笑着说道“呵呵，也没什么，这几天不是很多人都要拜见我吗？”
“是的，几乎所有的势力都拜访了。”
“好，你明天命下人，给所有来拜访过的人来发请帖，就说两天后，我在城主府会见各位！”
陈有财一听，顿时欣喜着说“是，我这就去办”这几天他老是拿好处不办事，都有点不好意思了，这次正好可以让自己心安一点。
“等等，还有，这次只邀请你收好处的，那些没拜访过的，送好处少的都先不邀请。等他们好处给你送到，你再给他们邀请函，知道吗？”
陈有财顿时觉得陈林对他太好了，处处都为自己着想，顿时感动的说“感谢少爷的栽培，我一定全心全意的为少爷办事。”
“好了，下去吧！”
陈林这次就是要给那些，眼高于顶的势力一个警告，陈家那怕再远也是神辉帝国的第一家族。至于让陈有财这么做就是让所有人都知道，那怕是陈家的奴才，也只必须要巴结着才行。
很快集镇城大部份势力，都收到了陈林两天后的邀请函，很多实力很强却没有前去拜访的势力，却没有收的邀请，顿时这些势力摸不清，这个陈家大少爷，到底是什么意思。
于是很多势力开始，偷偷的给城主送礼打听，也有一些势力仗着实力根本没有在意，但是明眼人还是看出来，这个陈大少爷，这次邀请定时风起云涌……
集镇城一座庄园中，一名老者恭敬和一名少年说道“少爷，你看这次陈林这是要做什么，竟然没有邀请我们刘家！”
“哼，一个被驱逐的过期少爷，能有什么作为，明天你代表刘家过去下就行了，不用放在心上！这次还是将上面的任务做好为主……”这少年满眼不屑，正是刘雷
在集镇城很多的势力，都是和刘雷的想法是一样的，既然你不请我过去，我自己派人过去拜访。做为集镇城的大势力，这个面子他总是要给的吧！
不过他们注定要失望，当晚陈林又叫来了陈有财吩咐道“明天，不论是谁来，都必须要邀请函，没有的！不论是谁，那怕他是皇子，也不能让他进来。”

“要是干闹事的，就让张叔在门口将他们轰走，还有就是将城内所有的士兵，明天都给我调过来……”
陈有财听陈林这么安排，顿时觉得很不妥“啊，那可是一千多人，安排在哪里啊？还有城里的治安怎么办？”
“这些人我自由安排，至于治安，你觉得这一千人，在五十万人的城池里能起到多大的作用？快去办吧，明天的宴会都安排好，不要落了陈家的面子……”陈林也没有解释道，接着就让陈有财前去准备。
等陈有财走后，陈林对着张叔说道：“张叔，明天要委屈你了，让你看门。”
“放心少爷，老奴一定会将大门看好的……”张叔明显也看出了陈林的用意，这是再利用他造势，陈林现在越是嚣张就越没有人敢轻视，毕竟陈林名义上可是陈家家主的独子！
“好，明天我就要让整个基德镇所有人都知道，谁是这里真正的主人……”
转眼第二天，城主府再次热闹起来，那些以前拜访过的，今天都欢欢喜喜的前来赴约，也有些自持身份自己前来，不过却被城主拒之门外。不论是谁，那怕以前从不睁眼看陈有财的人，今天也都是看请帖不看面子。
陈有财今天可是爽坏了，以前这些眼高于顶的大人物，今天都热情的和自己打招呼，还有那些没有请帖的人，直接被自己给拒之门外后的惊愕，陈有财从没想今天这样有面子过……
期间也有些大势力的公子哥，很不爽陈有财这样不讲情面，顿时自持身份想要硬闯，不过直接被一名七阶中级的高手扔了出去后，就再也没有人敢嚣张了……
这个场景顿时被前来拜访的刘家的老者看见，于是赶紧回去通知了自己家的少爷刘雷。
“什么让七阶高手看门？”刘雷听到老者叙述，顿时有些吃惊。七阶的强者他不是没有，可是每一个要供着地位都相当高。
“这个陈林到底是怎么回事，明明已经被驱逐出门了，怎么还会这么嚣张？”
陈林在城主府会见各个势力，嚣张的举动让所有的势力都不敢再轻视，都认为这个陈家的少爷，是代表着整个陈家。
时间马上就要到中午了，所有被邀请的人都到了，可是这次邀请大家的主角，却迟迟没有现身，只有陈有财这个城主，一直在招呼着大家。
直到快中午马上就要开宴席的时候，陈林才缓缓走出来“真是抱歉，刚来集镇城水土不服，身体有点不适，让大家久等了，真是抱歉！”
陈林在扯了一个谁都不信的理由，和所有人都寒暄了几句后，直接进入了主题“我想大家都想知道，我这次请大家来有什么用意……”
陈林顿了顿，见所有人都看向自己后，才又接着说道“我这次就是和大家，讨论下关于基德镇的治安的问题！我一路走来深感体会，基德镇的土匪、强盗、山贼太多了，就连我这里来都被劫了好几次……”
听陈林这么一说，下面都开始大骂匪盗猖獗，陈林接着又说道“现在领地里却没有足够的力量围剿，所以从现在起，所有奴隶交易的税收，全部提高到交易额的百分之十五……”

Chapter 26 Inviting all parties
Liu Lei never expected that the woman he liked was actually Chen Lin's woman. Although he was very disdainful of Chen Lin, the most surprising thing was that Chen Lin was protected by a seventh-level master. You should know that a seventh-level guard has a high status even in the Chen family.
"How could Chen Lin, who was expelled from his home, have such a strong guard?" But after thinking about it, Liu Lei sneered, "Are you the only one with a seventh-level master? If an expelled person dies suddenly at the border, the Chen family will not react..."
It is said that after Chen Lin eliminated Liu Lei's men, he returned to the city lord's palace with Cui'er. However, Chen Lin did not intend to just let it go. Chen Lin was a person who had to avenge himself. Liu Lei offended him twice, so Chen Lin did not intend to let it go.
This time, it was mainly because Cui'er was here. Chen Lin was afraid of hurting Cui'er, so he didn't attack directly. After returning to the city lord's palace, he directly ordered his subordinates, "Go, call Chen Youcai here, tell him that I have something to discuss with him, and ask him to put down everything he is doing and come over."
After just a moment, Chen Youcai ran over quickly, "Master, do you have a problem with me?"
Looking at Chen Youcai who was sweating profusely from running, Chen Lin smiled and said, "Haha, it's nothing. Aren't many people going to see me these days?"
"Yes, almost all the forces have visited."
"Okay, you will order someone to send invitations to everyone who comes to visit tomorrow. Just say that I will meet you at the City Lord's Mansion in two days!"
When Chen Youcai heard this, he immediately said with joy, "Yes, I'll do it right away." He had been feeling a little embarrassed these days when he kept taking advantage of the situation and not doing things. This time, he could just put his mind at ease a little bit more.
"Wait, also, this time I will only invite you to receive benefits. Those who have never visited before and those who will give you few benefits will not be invited. Wait until their benefits are delivered to you, and then you will give them invitation letters. Do you understand?"
Chen Youcai immediately felt that Chen Lin was too kind to him and always thought of himself. He was immediately moved and said, "Thank you for your cultivation, young master. I will serve you wholeheartedly."
"Okay, let's get down!"
This time, Chen Lin wanted to give a warning to those forces that had their eyes set on the top. No matter how far away the Chen family was, it was still the first family in the Shenhui Empire. As for letting Chen Youcai do this, he wanted everyone to know that even the servants of the Chen family had to fawn over him.
Soon, most of the forces in the market town received the invitation letter from Chen Lin two days later. Many powerful forces who did not go to visit did not accept the invitation. Suddenly, these forces were confused about what the eldest young master of the Chen family meant.
So many forces began to secretly send gifts to the city lord and inquire about it. Some forces relied on their strength and didn't pay attention at all. However, people with a discerning eye could still see that this invitation from Mr. Chen was going to be a storm...
In a manor in the market town, an old man respectfully said to a young man, "Master, look what Chen Lin is going to do this time. He didn't even invite our Liu family!"
"Hmph, what can an expelled expired young master do? Tomorrow you can go there on behalf of the Liu family. Don't worry about it! This time, the main thing is to do the above tasks well..." This young man was full of disdain. It was Liu Lei.
Many forces in the market town have the same idea as Liu Lei. Since you don't invite me, I will send someone to visit myself. As a major force in the market town, he must always give this face!
However, they were destined to be disappointed. That night, Chen Lin called Chen Youcai again and said, "Tomorrow, no matter who comes, they must get an invitation letter. No one! No matter who it is, even if he is a prince, he cannot be allowed in."
"If they are causing trouble, let Uncle Zhang blast them away at the door, and also transfer all the soldiers in the city to me tomorrow..."
When Chen Youcai heard Chen Lin's arrangement, he immediately felt that it was very inappropriate."Ah, there are more than a thousand people there. Where are they arranged? And what about the security in the city?"
"I can arrange these people freely. As for public security, how big an effect do you think these one thousand people can have in a city of 500,000 people? Go and do it quickly. Tomorrow's banquet has been arranged. Don't let the Chen family lose face..." Chen Lin did not explain, and then asked Chen Youcai to prepare.
After Chen Youcai left, Chen Lin said to Uncle Zhang, "Uncle Zhang, I will wrong you tomorrow and ask you to guard the door."
"Don't worry, young master, I will definitely take good care of the door..." Uncle Zhang also clearly saw Chen Lin's intention, which was to use him to build momentum. The more arrogant Chen Lin is now, the more no one dares to look down on him. After all, Chen Lin is nominally the only son of the head of the Chen family!
"Okay, tomorrow I will let everyone in Kidd Town know who is the real owner here..."
In the blink of an eye, the next day, the City Lord's Mansion became lively again. Those who had visited before came to attend the appointment happily, and some came on their own with their own identities, but they were turned away by the City Lord. No matter who it was, even those who had never opened their eyes to look at Chen Youcai before, today they read the invitation without caring about face.
Chen Youcai was so happy today. All the big shots who used to have high standards greeted him enthusiastically today, and those who didn't have invitations were shocked when they were turned away by him. Chen Youcai had never thought that he would be so proud today...
During this period, there were also some powerful young masters who were dissatisfied with Chen Youcai's lack of mercy. They immediately asserted their identity and tried to force their way in. However, after being thrown out by a seventh-level intermediate master, no one dared to be arrogant anymore...
This scene was immediately seen by the old man of the Liu family who came to visit, so he hurried back and informed his young master Liu Lei.
"Why do you let a seventh-level master guard the door?" Liu Lei was a little surprised when he heard the old man's narration. It's not that he doesn't have seventh-level experts, but each of them has a very high status.
"What's going on with this Chen Lin? He's been expelled, so why is he still so arrogant?"
Chen Lin met with various forces in the city lord's palace. His arrogant behavior made all the forces no longer dare to look down upon him. They all believed that this young master of the Chen family represented the entire Chen family.
It was almost noon, and everyone who had been invited had arrived. However, the protagonist who invited everyone this time had not yet appeared. Only the city lord, Chen Youcai, had been greeting everyone.
It wasn't until the banquet was about to start at noon that Chen Lin slowly walked out, "I'm really sorry. I just came to the market and I'm not used to the acclimatization and I feel a little unwell. I'm really sorry for keeping everyone waiting for so long!"
Chen Lin gave a reason that no one believed, and after chatting with everyone for a few words, he went directly to the topic, "I think everyone wants to know what my purpose is in inviting you here this time..."
Chen Lin paused for a moment. After seeing everyone looking at him, he continued, "This time I am discussing with you all the security issues in Kidd Town! I have come to realize that there are too many bandits, robbers, and bandits in Kidd Town. Even when I came here, I was robbed several times..."
After hearing what Chen Lin said, everyone began to curse the rampant banditry. Chen Lin went on to say, "Now the territory does not have enough power to encircle and suppress, so from now on, the tax on all slave transactions will be increased to 15% of the transaction amount..."
